zh: 全新上线 AI-BI 智能敏捷看板与交互式报表大屏：集成图表组件库、取数查询引擎与可视化参数面板，支持自然语言对话即时生成敏捷数据看板，实时联动平台业务数据与图表视图渲染。
移动端底层通信与设置持久化架构重构：全面优化 Android 与 iOS 双端平台网络客户端（PlatformHttpClient）与本地配置管理器（SettingsManager），支持流式会话保持、凭据无缝同步与离线存储保护。
云端构建流水线与发布签名增强：Android 构建工作流全面接入稳定 Release 密钥签名机制与单元测试自动化校验，确保客户端发布包跨版本平滑无缝升级。
en: Introduce AI-BI intelligent agile dashboards and interactive reporting: integrate chart component library, query compute engine, and visual parameter panel to generate agile business dashboards from conversational prompts in real time.

Refactor mobile cross-platform networking and settings persistence: overhaul PlatformHttpClient and SettingsManager across Android and iOS, supporting persistent streaming sessions, secure credential synchronization, and offline storage protection.

Enhance cloud CI/CD release signing and automated testing: integrate stable Android release keystore signing and automated unit tests into the GitHub Actions workflow, ensuring smooth seamless cross-release app upgrades.
